_noteE: Snowball Barrage: TotalSnowballDamage (despite its name) is the PER-SNOWBALL hit (BaseDamage + 0.12x AP), matching wiki 'Magic Damage Per Hit: 15/22.5/30/37.5/45 (+12% AP)'; curated with count 3 for the volley's 3 snowballs, matching wiki's headline 'Total Magic Damage: 45/67.5/90/112.5/135 (+36% AP)'. The 2 optional recasts (same damage again) are NOT modeled via castCount -- situational multi-target cleanup, not a baseline single-target combo assumption (P2 conservative).
